text.label: Text
text.description: Intermediate narrative text produced by the model between tool calls.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.description: The model's reasoning content, when provided by the provider.

tool.label: Tool
tool.description: A single tool call with its input and result. Edit and Write output is shown as a diff.

delta.label: Stream fragment
delta.description: A live text fragment received while a reply is generated token by token. Temporary; the full text is written to the message.

ask.label: Question
ask.description: The ask_user tool asks the user a question and waits for an answer, suspending the turn. Temporary; once answered, the tool step becomes permanent.

permission.label: Permission approval
permission.description: A permission gate in ask mode waits for user approval before a write or command tool runs. Temporary; after the decision, the tool runs or records a permission_denied error. Used by both the native and claude-cli permission-prompt paths.

plan.label: Plan approval
plan.description: Plan approval for claude-cli: the agent presents its plan with ExitPlanMode and waits for the user. Approval continues the turn; rejection lets the model revise the plan. Used only in ask and read-only modes; autonomous turns approve it automatically.

todo.label: Task list
todo.description: The todo_write tool's working checklist, rendered as a first-class card.

recovery.label: Recovery
recovery.description: The loop left the happy path, for example by reaching its iteration limit. Reason contains a machine label.

error.label: Error
error.description: A turn-level error such as a provider failure, budget overrun, or cancellation, separate from a tool error marked with tool+isError.

steer.label: Steering
steer.description: User guidance added live to a running turn, displayed separately from the model.

tool_delta.label: Tool output stream
tool_delta.description: Kept only for reading old persisted sessions. New tool output fragments use the generic Append contract.

tombstone.label: Retraction
tombstone.description: Removes a live step whose final card cannot arrive because of cancellation or panic. Ref identifies the target step. The tombstone itself is not rendered.

diff.label: File change
diff.description: A file change made with Write or Edit, shown with its path, added and removed line counts, and an expandable unified diff.

hook.label: Hook
hook.description: A user-defined PreToolUse or PostToolUse hook ran around a tool call. It may change input or output, approve automatically, add context, or block the call. Reason carries the machine decision. Available only on the native anthropic/minimax path.

context_change.label: Context change
context_change.description: The session's frozen static context changed during the session. To preserve the prompt cache, the cached prefix still contains the session-start snapshot. Changed blocks appear as a diff, and the change is fully applied on the next context refresh.

cache_break.label: Cache break
cache_break.description: This turn lost the session's warm prompt-cache prefix and paid for it again from cold. Cards are shown for model, system prompt, or tool schema changes; normal TTL cooling after a long idle period does not create a card.

compaction.label: Context compaction
compaction.description: Session history was folded into a rolling summary to stay within the context budget. The card shows the message count, context sizes, trigger, source, and CLI session operation. Raw messages leave model context but remain unchanged on disk.

subagent.label: Subagent
subagent.description: An isolated subagent started with run_subagent performs a task in its own clean context and returns only its final result. Expanding the card shows the subagent's nested trace. Multiple calls in one turn run in parallel.
